blocks.content: The goal of this project is to request movie data from a web source, handle the response, and display the relevant data using fetch().
We'll do it in the following steps:

items: Make a GET Request to the Web Source
Handle Response and Check for Errors
Extract Movie Names with Ratings Greater than or Equal to 9
